Lih Pao (立报) and other local newspapers :-

"REVIEW OF JAPANESE NAVY IN HONGKEW PARK : EXTRAORDINARY
PRECAUTIONS ADOPTED IN HONGKEW DISTRICT : A REVIEW OR
A DEMONSTRATION? ALL SPECTATORS SEARCHED AS A PRECAUTION
AGAINST ASSASSINS"

A review of more than 2,000 officers
and men of the Third Fleet of the Japanese Navy in harbour
was held in the Hongkew Park yesterday morning. About
10,000 Japanese residents were present to watch the review.
It was a military review as well as a demonstration.
As a precaution against a repetition of
the Shirakawa incident, in which Baron General Shirakawa,
Commander-in-Chief of the local Japanese Army was killed
and 12 high naval officials were wounded as a result of
a bomb thrown by Ying Feng Chi (尹奉吉), member of the
Korean Independent Clique, during a military review which
took place in the Hongkew Park on April 29, 1932, strict
precautionary measures were adopted in the vicinity of
Hongkew Park. Chinese and foreign detectives and Sikh
policemen of the Shanghai Municipal Police patrolled
the various streets from Dixwell Road to Kiangwan Road.
At every road intersection between Chinese controlled
territory and the Settlement, groups of Chapei policemen
were on guard, while inside the Hongkew Park a large number
of policemen and Japanese marines were on duty. A cordon
of Japanese marines surrounded the platform to a distance
of several feet. No unauthorized person was allowed
inside this cordon. People carrying parcels were subjected
to a rigid search before they were admitted into the park.
All these precautions were taken to prevent a second Ying
Feng Chi, a bomb thrower, from gaining admittance.
The review commenced at 10.30 a.m.
Among those on the platform were General Yang Fu, the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner, General Wu Teh Chen,
Mayor of Shanghai, and General Tsai Ching Chun, Commissioner
of the Bureau of Police. The six beautiful girls sent from
Tokyo to console the marines attracted the most attention.
More than 100 military pigeons were used in the review.
The proceedings terminated at 10.40 a.m.
The discharge of rifles and machine guns
caused great alarm among the people living in the
vicinity.

Lih Pao :-

JAPANESE CREATE TROUBLE ON CHENGTU ROAD

At about 3 p.m., January 3, a drunken
Japanese named I. Suzuki, residing at No. 982 Bubbling
Well Road, and a friend named Hayashi became involved in
an altercation with several second hand goods stall keepers
in the vicinity of Chengtu Road and Avenue Edward VII. A
fight took place. A large party of Police arrived shortly
afterwards and succeeded in separating the two parties.

《立报》及其他本地报纸：-

“虹口公园日本海军阅兵：虹口区采取非常预防措施：是阅兵还是示威？为防范刺客，所有观众均受搜查”

昨日上午，停泊在港的日本海军第三舰队2000余名官兵在虹口公园举行了阅兵式。约1万名日侨到场观看阅兵。这既是一次军事阅兵，也是一次武力展示。

为防止1932年4月29日在虹口公园举行的阅兵式中发生的白川事件重演——当时朝鲜独立运动成员尹奉吉投掷炸弹，炸死当地日军司令官白川义则大将，并炸伤12名海军高级官员——虹口公园附近采取了严格的预防措施。上海公共租界警务处的中西探员及锡克族巡捕在从狄思威路（Dixwell Road）到江湾路（Kiangwan Road）的各条街道巡逻。在华界与租界交界的每个路口，均有闸北警察把守，而虹口公园内则有大量巡捕和日本海军陆战队员执勤。一队日本海军陆战队员在讲台周围数英尺处设立警戒线。未经授权者不得进入该警戒线内。携带包裹者在获准进入公园前须接受严格搜查。采取所有这些预防措施是为了防止第二个投弹刺客尹奉吉混入。

阅兵式于上午10时30分开始。
站在讲台上的有淞沪警备司令杨虎将军、上海市市长吴铁城将军和公安局局长蔡劲军将军。从东京派来慰问海军陆战队的六名美女最引人注目。阅兵式中使用了100多只军鸽。
活动于上午10时40分结束。
步枪和机枪的射击声引起了附近居民的极大恐慌。

《立报》：-

日本人在成都路滋事

1月3日下午3时许，一名居住在静安寺路982号的醉酒日本人I. Suzuki（音译）及其朋友Hayashi（音译），在成都路与爱文义路（Avenue Edward VII）附近与几名旧货摊贩发生争执。随后发生了斗殴。大批警察随即赶到，成功将双方分开。

The New Year's Parade of the Japanese 3rd Fleet and the
Naval Landing Party will be held on Kiangwan Road and in

Vice-Admiral Hasegawa, Commander-in-Chief of the 3rd Fleet.

Japanese officials and foreign military and naval officers
are expected to attend. A large number of local Japanese
residents are also expected to turn out both on Kiangwan Road

the units on foot will assemble in the park by 8.30 a.m. and

10.30 a.m. they will proceed south along Kiangwan Road to be

will occupy a position on the east pavement of the road about
**〔此处转录不清〕** yards south of the main entrance to the Shanghai Shrine.

主题：日本第三舰队及海军陆战队拟于1936年1月4日举行新年阅兵。

由 D.S. Kamashita 撰写 由 **〔此处转录不清〕** 转呈

日本第三舰队及海军陆战队的新年阅兵将于1937年1月4日在江湾路及虹口公园举行，由海军陆战队指挥官大越（Okochi，音译）少将指挥。约2000名海军陆战队官兵（包括驻扎在租界各处的分队）及目前停泊在港的军舰水兵将参加阅兵。第三舰队司令长谷川清（Hasegawa，音译）中将将检阅阅兵式。活动预计于中午12时左右结束。预计日本高官及外国军方和海军军官将出席。预计大量本地日侨将在江湾路及虹口公园出动观看展示。1月4日，徒步部队将于上午8时30分前在公园集结，并在阅兵开始前进行排练。

December 31, 1935. Morning Translation.

NIPPO

JAPANESE CONSULAR POLICE TO CANCEL SPECIAL
PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES.

At midnight December 31-
January 1, the local Japanese Consular Police will
cancel the special precautionary measures against
crime.

JAPANESE LANDING PARTY TO HOLD REHEARSAL PARADE
TO-DAY IN HONGKEW PARK

At the Hongkew Park on January 4,
1936, Vice-Admiral Oikawa, Commander of the Third Fleet,
will review a grand parade of Japanese naval forces
stationed in Shanghai.

A rehearsal parade will be
held by the Japanese Landing Party to-day in Hongkew
Park. It is expected that 1,500 marines will take part
in the grand parade on January 4.

Subject (in full) Annual parade of Japanese Naval Landing Party to be
held in Hongkew Park on January 4, 1935.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by JSRm A.

The local Japanese Naval Landing Party under the command
of Rear-admiral Araki, Commander of the Landing Party, will
hold a parade, which will be reviewed by Vice-admiral
Hyakutake, Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese Third Fleet,
on Kiangwan Road and in Hongkew Park between 10.30 a.m. and
11.30 a.m. January 4, 1935. Some 1,600 officers and men from
the Landing Party and warships of the Third Fleet at present
in harbour as well as the Artillery and Armoured-car units
will participate.

All the Artillery gun carriages and armoured cars will
be parked on Kiangwan Road in the vicinity of the Swimming
Pool. At 10.30 a.m. they will proceed south along Kiangwan
Road to be reviewed by Vice-admiral Hyakutake, who, together
with Senior Japanese and Chinese officials as well as foreign
naval officers will occupy a position on the east side of the
road about 10 yards south to the entrance of the Shanghai
Shrine. The units will then enter Darroch Road and proceed
along the following roads:- North Szechuen, Kiangwan and
Wonglo Roads.

Following the review of the Artillery and Armoured-car
Corps, the Vice-admiral, accompanied by the other notables
present, will enter Hongkew Park where a parade of the other
units will be carried out.

Vice-admiral Hyakutake will land at the Customs Jetty
at about 10.20 a.m. January 4, 1935 and proceed by motor-car
to the Headquarters of the Japanese Naval Landing Party,
Kiangwan Road. No Police escort is requested by the Japanese
Naval Authorities. Mr. A. Ariyoshi, Japanese Minister to
China, General Wu Teh Chen, Mayor of Shanghai, and several

事由（全称） 日本海军陆战队年度阅兵将于1935年1月4日在虹口公园举行。

制作人 D. S. Umemoto。转呈人 JSRm A.

由陆战队指挥官荒木少将（Rear-admiral Araki）指挥的当地日本海军陆战队，将于1935年1月4日上午10:30至11:30在江湾路和虹口公园举行阅兵，由日本第三舰队司令长官百武中将（Vice-admiral Hyakutake）检阅。约1,600名来自陆战队和目前停泊在港口的第三舰队战舰的官兵，以及炮兵和装甲车部队将参加。

所有火炮炮架和装甲车将停放在游泳池附近的江湾路上。上午10:30，它们将沿江湾路向南行进，接受百武中将的检阅，百武中将将与日本和中国的高级官员以及外国海军军官一起，占据位于上海神社入口以南约10码的道路东侧的位置。随后部队将进入达罗克路，并沿以下道路行进：- 北四川路、江湾路和永乐路。

在检阅炮兵和装甲车队之后，中将将由其他在场贵宾陪同进入虹口公园，在那里将对其他部队进行阅兵。
